weights.source: the C1 checkpoint (models/weights, trained on 2026-09-12 on the training cache; the fingerprint recorded in the 300 C1 rows of attacknet_v2_1__nuaa)

cache_0ac7143.role: the extractor that built the training cache nuaa_1500.npz of 2026-09-12 (reproduced bit for bit by N2: 6,000/6,000 cache frames); same copy as delivery/n2/face_0ac7143.py
cache_0ac7143.retinaface_box: w, h = int(min(W, r) - x + 1), int(min(H, b) - y + 1)

c1_a80f6f9.role: the extractor of the C1 evaluation of 2026-09-28 (application src/tesi_app/face.py since commit 44971f3 of 2026-09-24, unchanged since: the current file must have this SHA-256, checked)
c1_a80f6f9.retinaface_box: w, h = int(min(W, r)) - x, int(min(H, b)) - y

difference: with the C1 extractor the RetinaFace box is 1 px narrower and 1 px shorter (the +1 removed on 2026-09-24 in commit 44971f3); detector, face choice (highest confidence, minimum 0.6, boxes under 16 px rejected), Haar cascade fallback, margin 0.15, square crop and the whole-image fallback are identical in the two files
chain: cv2.imread (BGR) -> detector -> Face.crop(margin=0.15, square=True), the whole frame when no face is found -> cv2.resize 256x256 INTER_AREA -> BGR to RGB -> advanced_image_enhancement (reference create_datasets.py) -> uint8 -> float32 / 255 at scoring: scripts/train_cnn.py preprocess, unchanged (the chain of the training cache and, extractor for extractor, of the application analyzer used in C1: same enhancement steps, same reader)
threshold_origin: fixed a priori in C1 (nuaa_config.json) and unchanged; no calibration on the test, no new threshold, no score inversion

frames.rule: the 300 C1 images preprocessed with the cache extractor must equal bit for bit their rows of X_test (sampling order of the official test list, as in N1 and N2); any difference stops the study before any score (the chain of the cache is then not reconstructed)

parity.stored_device: the C1 scores were computed by the application on the Metal GPU, one image at a time; here CPU, batch 16

c1_conditions.note: informative only: the default device of this process, one image at a time, as the application computed the C1 scores; not the scoring of the study

cpu_batch1.note: informative only: the CPU one image at a time (a CPU replication of the stored scores one image at a time, as an R2-like run would do); not the scoring of the study

selection: none: both extractors reported on the same images with the same checkpoint and threshold; no score inversion

figures.figure_paired.png: paired attack scores per image (C1 extractor on x, cache extractor on y), one colour per class, no identifiers
